status: UNCONSTRAINED DESIGN SEARCH, deployable UAV v0.1 (canon set aside, physics kept). Every assumption is authored and visible. Not canon, not engineering.
brief: kT 2026-10-24: a deployable UAV that rides with the shuttle or is dropped alone by Wayfarer; roles: scout ahead of the shuttle, overwatch and relay for crew, fetch samples, long-endurance survey; atmosphere worlds (Earth, Mars, Titan, Venus clouds); size decided by the search.

ingenuity.what: 1.8 kg coaxial, 1.21 m rotors, 350 W typical input, 72 flights, longest 704 m

mars_heli_capabilities.what: Mars Science Helicopter hexacopter: 6 x 1.28 m rotors, 32.5 kg, solidity 0.25, Ct/sigma 0.12, hover tip Mach 0.8, disk loading 15.6 N/m2; 24.9 km range or 11.1 min hover empty, 14.2 km with 5 kg

mahd.what: Mid-Air Helicopter Delivery: 31 kg helicopter plus 47-50 kg jetpack separates at ~600 m, hovers at 200 m, helicopter takes off in mid-air; 275 kg entry mass, no lander

dragonfly.what: Titan octocopter: ~450 kg, 8 x 1.35 m rotors, MMRTG ~70 W charging a battery, ~30 min and up to 8-16 km per flight at ~10 m/s; released from its parachute at ~1.2 km and flies to the ground; launch July 2028

ares.what: ARES Mars airplane: 6.25 m span, 175 kg at pull-out, Mach 0.65 (~140 m/s) at 1-2 km, 500+ km range on a rocket motor; folded wings, deployed mid-air from a 2.65 m aeroshell

vamp.what: Venus flying wing: 55 m span, 900 kg, 10% buoyant, solar 8 kW+, cruises 110 km/h at 50-65 km, enters without an aeroshell

venus_winds.what: Venus Express: zonal winds ~60 m/s at 44-64 km, ~102 m/s at the cloud tops

laser_beaming.what: Lockheed Martin Stalker UAV kept aloft 48 h by laser power beaming (LaserMotive, 2012)

Mars.note: density near the ground, thin; sets rotor size; Ingenuity-class efficiency (ROAMX)

Titan.note: 94 K: heated, insulated avionics and battery (Dragonfly uses RTG waste heat); haze blocks beams; sunlight ~0.1% of Earth's

Venus clouds.note: 55 km, 27 C, 0.5 bar; sulfuric acid haze needs coatings; 60 m/s winds; insolation authored for a drone drifting with the clouds (sun about half the time)

rotor.basis: Mars Science Helicopter design point; cruise power ~0.8 of hover at ~30 m/s matches its range vs hover time; blade/hub/arm mass authored
rotor.layout: three coaxial pairs on folding arms (Y6); disc area counts each pair once; coaxial losses folded into the figure of merit

wing.basis: ARES-class wing sized for Mars at 100 m/s; folds for stowage; elsewhere it flies slower on the same wing

mass.basis: authored; sensor kit = cameras, lidar, radio relay; motors include drives

notes: battery 600 Wh/kg is a 2226 assumption (2026 packs ~250-300; lithium-sulfur cells ~400-500)
rps: radioisotope power at 8 W/kg is a 2226 assumption (MMRTG ~2.5 W/kg)
solar panels fold out on the ground to recharge
beam: laser power from the landed shuttle, line of sight, clear air only

scout.note: one charge, cruise, out and back 20 km

overwatch.note: on station per charge (hover for rotor-only, circling for winged); or unlimited near the shuttle with beamed power

fetch.note: vertical take-off and landing with a 5 kg sample case, 10 km round trip loaded

survey.note: alone, recharging from its own source; Dragonfly-style hops

HYBRID.label: Multirotor plus folding wing (lift and cruise)

drop_pod.basis: umbrella areal mass from the shuttle heat-shield model at low ballistic coefficient; Mars jetpack per MAHD (47 kg for a 31 kg helicopter); elsewhere a parachute and mid-air release like Dragonfly; slot = one of Wayfarer's six ~1.75 t drone berths (canon compendium)

stowage.note: authored envelope per drone: a side bay on the shuttle's lowest deck; in the landing version the deck no longer holds a separate rover
